name: STEMulus WebMCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for automated AI agents to discover curriculum, inspect schedules, book free 1-on-1 trial classes, and enroll students into STEMulus Kids Tech.

tools.name: get_courses
tools.description: Query STEMulus course catalog, age brackets, pricing, and curriculum milestones.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check available 1-on-1 trial class slots for any programming course and date.

tools.name: book_trial_class
tools.description: Book a free 45-minute 1-on-1 trial coding class with Google Meet link and dual reminders.

tools.name: enroll_student
tools.description: Programmatically enroll a student, provision student ID, and create parent portal account.
